title: Getting started with streamMOA
text: Install package CRAN load together stream:
code: install.packages(c("stream", "streamMOA")) library(streamMOA) library(stream)

title: Getting started with streamMOA
text: DSD_Gaussians() stream generates stream three clusters small amount noise. Request finite number observations get_points(): Stream observations generated requested, plotting retrieving points advances stream. Set info = FALSE feature values needed cluster labels required.

title: Getting started with streamMOA
text: DSC_CluStream() creates MOA-based online clusterer. m parameter sets maximum number micro-clusters, horizon controls time window. optional k argument enables weighted k-means reclustering produce macro-clusters. Use update() train clusterer incoming observations:
code: clustering <- DSC_CluStream(m = 50, horizon = 100, k = 3) update(clustering, stream, n = 500) clustering #> CluStream  #> Class: moa/clusterers/clustream/WithKmeans, DSC_MOA, DSC_Micro, DSC  #> Number of micro-clusters: 50  #> Number of macro-clusters: 3

title: Getting started with streamMOA
text: micro-clusters summarize recent observations. Macro-clusters group summaries smaller number clusters. Retrieve centers plot stream:  clusterers include DSC_DenStream(), DSC_ClusTree(), DSC_DStream_MOA(), DSC_BICO_MOA(), DSC_StreamKM(). See help pages package vignette Introduction streamMOA algorithm details, options, additional examples.

title: Interface for MOA Stream Clustering Algorithms
text: Create 3 clusters 5% noise. Cluster CluStream. Plot micro-clusters.
code: library(streamMOA)  stream <- DSD_Gaussians(k = 3, d = 2, noise = 0.05) clustream <- DSC_CluStream(m = 50, k = 3) update(clustream, stream, 500) clustream ## CluStream  ## Class: moa/clusterers/clustream/WithKmeans, DSC_MOA, DSC_Micro, DSC  ## Number of micro-clusters: 50  ## Number of macro-clusters: 3 plot(clustream, stream)

title: BICO: Fast computation of k-means coresets in a data stream — DSC_BICO_MOA
text: BICO maintains tree inspired clustering tree BIRCH, SIGMOD Test Time award-winning clustering algorithm. node tree represents subset points. Instead storing points individual objects, number points, sum squared sum subset's points stored key features subset. Points inserted exactly one node.

code: # data with 3 clusters set.seed(1000) stream <- DSD_Gaussians(k = 3, d = 2, noise = 0.05)  clustree <- DSC_ClusTree(maxHeight = 3) update(clustree, stream, 500) clustree #> ClusTree  #> Class: moa/clusterers/clustree/ClusTree, DSC_MOA, DSC_Micro, DSC  #> Number of micro-clusters: 27   plot(clustree, stream)   # Use the k-means reclusterer with k = 3 to create macro-clusters clustree <- DSC_ClusTree(maxHeight = 3, k = 3) update(clustree, stream, 500) clustree #> ClusTree + k-Means (weighted)  #> Class: DSC_TwoStage, DSC_Macro, DSC  #> Number of micro-clusters: 29  #> Number of macro-clusters: 3   plot(clustree, stream, type = "both")

title: D-Stream Data Stream Clustering Algorithm — DSC_DStream_MOA
text: decayFactor Decay factor applied grid-cell density. Cm Threshold classifying grid cells dense. Cl Threshold classifying grid cells sparse. Beta Adjusts window protection renaming previously deleted grids sporadic.

title: D-Stream Data Stream Clustering Algorithm — DSC_DStream_MOA
text: D-Stream creates equally spaced grid estimates density grid cell using count points falling cells. Grid cells classified based density dense, transitional sporadic cells. density faded every new point decay factor. Notes implementation uses 1--1 grid, example expands data range. MOA implementation currently return micro-clusters.

text: epsilon Maximum radius micro-cluster. Must 0 1. mu Minimum weight required core micro-cluster. beta Weight multiplier used identify outlier micro-clusters. Must 0 1. lambda Decay constant. initPoints Number points used initialize algorithm DBSCAN. offline Multiplier applied epsilon reachability reclustering. Must 2 20. processingSpeed Number incoming points per time unit, used decay. Must 1 1000. recluster TRUE, apply offline reachability reclustering. k specified, choose reachability threshold produce number macro-clusters.

title: DenStream Data Stream Clusterer — DSC_DenStream
text: DenStream reclusters micro-clusters using DBSCAN-style reachability. threshold epsilon * offline (offline = 2 default). k specified, single-link hierarchical clustering chooses reachability threshold produces k macro-clusters.

title: DenStream Data Stream Clusterer — DSC_DenStream

title: Micro-cluster Continuous Outlier Detector (MCOD) — DSC_MCOD

title: Micro-cluster Continuous Outlier Detector (MCOD) — DSC_MCOD
code: # Example 1: Clustering with MCOD stream <- DSD_Gaussians(k = 3, d = 2, noise = 0.05) mcod <- DSC_MCOD(r = .1, t = 3, w = 100) update(mcod, stream, 100) mcod #> Micro-cluster outlier detector  #> Class: DSC_MCOD, DSC_Micro, DSC_MOA, DSC  #> Number of micro-clusters: 7   plot(mcod, stream, n = 100)   # Example 2: Predict outliers (have a class label of NA) stream <- DSD_Gaussians(k = 3, d = 2, noise = 0.05) mcod <- DSOutlier_MCOD(r = .1, t = 3, w = 100) update(mcod, stream, 100)  plot(mcod, stream, n = 100)   # Retrieve detected outlier positions. get_outlier_positions(mcod) #>         X1         X2 #> 1 0.491609 0.04416643  # Example 3: evaluate on a stream evaluate_static(mcod, stream, n = 100, type = "micro",   measure = c("crand", "noisePrecision", "outlierjaccard")) #> Evaluation results for micro-clusters. #> Points were assigned to micro-clusters. #>  #>          cRand noisePrecision outlierJaccard  #>      0.5138289      1.0000000      1.0000000  #> attr(,"type") #> [1] "micro" #> attr(,"assign") #> [1] "micro"
